method: Root/GPT predeclared bounded coordinate tuning of two frozen architectures: A original network and B previously GPT-generated indicator program; internal parameters fitted normally, no new GPT calls or new structure evolution.

audit.interpretation: Two-fold tuning improved the reused development benchmark; every frozen round champion was worse than fixed A on reserved July. All adjusted intervals are negative and the frozen absolute 0.005 increment was not met. No independent predictive benefit is established. Nested predictive indicates future-target task type only; predictive_claim_supported is false for all actual comparisons. Even if true it would only mean a development comparison threshold passed, not independent confirmation.
limitations: All 2025 periods were already exposed; July is development evidence
Two fixed seeds describe one ensemble, not random-seed generalization
24h calendar-block bootstrap with 2000 resamples is approximate and can miss longer dependence
CI refers to absolute logMSE differences; relative percentages are descriptive
audit.audit_actions: Read-only artifacts and product source; no training, no GPT calls, wrote only work/operator_v5_tuning/result_audit.json

interpretation_artifact_reviewed.statement: Three frozen coordinate rounds improved the selected May/June benchmark, but the final July reserved development evaluation worsened. This run does not support promotion or independent predictive benefit.
interpretation_artifact_reviewed.raw_predictive_claim_supported_semantics: The inherited paired_comparison field means the conditional bootstrap interval clears the predefined numerical threshold. Even if true, it would not override previously exposed development scope or establish independent confirmation.

posthoc_diagnosis.identity_resolution: Exact configuration.json config equality against parameters_frozen.json; no heldout-score selection
posthoc_diagnosis.aggregation: Equal symbols within UTC prediction-origin hour, then equal hours; by-symbol single symbol; UTC calendar weeks Monday 00:00 inclusive to next Monday exclusive; first/final partial weeks kept
limitations: Subgroups chosen after results are descriptive, not predeclared significance tests or new selection gates.
July was reserved from the three-round tuning choice but already historically exposed development data; not independent confirmation.
Changed architecture, training length, LR and L2 together: this comparison does not isolate new formula value, internal parameter value or noise-overfitting mechanism.
A worsened reserved score after dev selection is compatible with sample variability, regime differences, objective tradeoffs and selection effects; these data do not identify which caused it.
Nonzero alpha update proves fitted parameters changed, not that their updates improved predictions.
five_key_findings: July主任务loss从0.185384631升到0.200272881，恶化8.031%；同一2193个有标签样本、731个UTC小时。
三币主任务均恶化：BTC12.071%、ETH0.864%、SOL9.336%，差异不是只由一个币种方向反转。
五个UTC Monday周段中四个恶化，最大为7月21日周27.359%；7月28日仅83小时部分周改善0.413%。这是事后分组描述，无额外显著性结论。
辅助first_event NLL从2.326670升到3.041352，恶化30.717%；2169个有标签样本、723小时，三个币种均恶化。辅助指标未进入选择门槛。
B程序参数确实更新：July seed17/29 alpha_baseline从0.08到0.079669/0.079641、alpha_recent从0.4到0.403344/0.401549；这不证明这些更新有收益。
posthoc_diagnosis.interpretation: 开发选优后留存期变差，是跨时期改善没有延续的证据。单凭这种症状，不能断言是噪声过拟合、辅助任务冲突或内部alpha训练造成；架构、训练时长、学习率和L2一起改变，缺少单因素消融和足够独立时期来识别机制。不得根据这些事后分组改变参数选择或评价门槛。
